_meta.description: Plan flows straight from a long panel (one row per customer per month-end snapshot), no pre-pivot: ATTR_PREVIOUS_STATE adds each row's plan at the customer's previous snapshot, typed as plan with plan's dictionary, so the prev_plan x plan count crosstab is the transition table and the three flows overlays read it as they read a wide from x to table. OVERLAY_MARKOV gives the transition matrix, its 1- and 3-step powers and the plan mix projected from the observed margin; OVERLAY_SYMMETRY tests whether customers moved between each pair of plans as often one way as back; OVERLAY_RETENTION gives each plan's stay and switch rates. Each customer's first snapshot has no previous plan and reaches no cell. A state seen only as a later state (a churned with no move out) is a column-only key: name it in the Markov and retention absorbing lists, or Markov refuses PULSE_OVERLAY_MATRIX_NOT_SQUARE.
_meta.name: crosstab-previous-state-flows
